notes.title: New Update Now Available!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Another Prologue update marks another step in our journey towards the full game release. In addition to immersing you in the history of the Riese complex, we're excited to showcase our progress in developing the full version of The Riese Project.

This update introduces controller support for the FPP mode, a feature frequently requested by you. We'd love to hear your feedback - do the mapped buttons meet your expectations, or do you have other suggestions? Currently, we've focused on Xbox controller compatibility, but we believe the PlayStation controller will also work seamlessly.

We regularly add new graphics and audio elements to enhance your experience in both FPP and VR modes.

Wishing you happy gaming! 🎮

Real Invented Studio Team

For some time now, we have been intensively working on significant changes that will culminate in the soon-to-be-released update of special importance. Stay with us and support us with your reviews. They motivate us to work and we still have the passion to update our adventure.

Best regards,
Real Invented Studio Team

notes.title: The new update is now available!
notes.content:
Welcome the holidays with a dazzling update in The Riese Project Prologue. Our latest patch brings seasonal joy with new festive graphics and audio elements that will enliven your gaming experience.

What's New:

    Graphics: We are continually improving the visual quality, adding new assets.
    Audio: We are adding new tracks and sound effects. We invite many talented Artists to collaborate on the game's production. Thank you to Magda Milewska for lending the beautiful track "Man in The Red Coat", which you can listen to on the in-game radio.
    Gameplay: We optimize and improve the gameplay quality based on Player comments. We've added a flashlight button - it can now be activated from the phone UI level.

Join our Christmas event and share your experiences! Let this festive time be full of excitement in The Riese Project Prologue. We're waiting for you in the game!

We warmly greet you and wish you a Merry Christmas,
Real Invented Studio Team

notes.title: The new update is now available!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are thrilled to share exciting news about the latest update for The Riese Project - Prologue. Your support and patience have been invaluable, and working on this update has been a truly exhilarating challenge for us.

What's New:

    Transition to UE5.3 Engine: This is more than just a step forward; it's a genuine revolution! Immerse yourselves in the VR world with vastly improved graphics, more realistic lighting effects, and deeper experiences.

    Visual Enhancements: Every detail has been refined so you can behold the beauty of our world. New objects and increased details will make every minute spent in the game a delight for your eyes.

    Elevated Audio Experience: Sound is key to immersion, so we've enhanced the audio quality, added new sounds, and effects, allowing you to completely immerse yourselves in the magical sounds of our universe.

    Bug Fixes: Thank you for every bug report! Our team has focused on eliminating all known issues, ensuring a significant improvement in the overall gaming experience.

Thank you for being with us on this incredible journey! We hope the new update brings even more joy to your gameplay. Your feedback is immensely important to us, so don't forget to share it - it's through your input that we shape our world!

From the heart,
Real Invented Studio

notes.title: New patch is now live!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We're thrilled to announce another update to our game 'The Riese Project - Prologue'. We're excited to enhance your gaming experience with innovative narrative tools.

WHAT'S NEW IN THIS UPDATE:

- [b]VHS VCR, Tapes, and TV[/b]: This isn't just any regular player and tapes. In our game world, this feature becomes a key to uncovering side stories that add depth to the entire narrative. Get acquainted now with this tool, which will soon serve nostalgic memories and secrets hidden throughout the game. In future updates, VHS tapes will be scattered across various locations, with each linking to unique stories, immersing you deeper into our carefully crafted world.
- Graphic improvements
- Optimizations and corrections
- Added interactions to additional furniture
- More random comments

We hope these additions further immerse you into the world of 'The Riese Project'. Thank you for your continued support and enjoy your gameplay!

Best wishes to all!
